Companion __tests__/GuardModeWidgetParity.test.tsx mocks useGuardConfig/useGuardEvents (with the real isGuardEventAcknowledged) + useVehicles and covers: loading skeleton; standard armed (status card + ON + 'Sensitivity: high \u00b7 Auto-panic' + feed rows with Vehicle Moved/Unacknowledged + Unauthorized Unlock/Acknowledged + freshness); disarmed (no auto-panic suffix, OFF); standard empty feed ('No guard events'); compact (Armed badge + '2 events'); missing-config empty state ('No guard data'); error freshness chip; and the vehicleId fallback-to-first-vehicle vs explicit-vehicleId hook-call assertions. Every test unmounts so the 30s freshness interval leaves no open handle.
